title: wicked-pack.json — third-party pack manifest (skills, editors, blocks)
description: Drop-in registration manifest for a third-party pack (extension contract, SKILL-RATIONALIZATION §5). Spec 2 adds editors[] and blocks[] (DES-artifact-editor-plugins §5.2); spec-1 packs stay valid. Placed at the pack root next to its skills/ tree. Garden discovers it at runtime from WICKED_PACK_PATH, the registered-pack file, Claude Code plugin dirs, and <project>/.wicked/packs/ — no garden PR required. Executable validation: `npx wicked-garden pack check <dir>` (scripts/pack/check.py).

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editors.

spec.description: Manifest spec version. 1: skills only. 2: adds editors[] and blocks[]; domains becomes optional when editors is present.

name.description: Pack name, kebab-case, must start with the vendor prefix (e.g. acme-seo). The wicked* prefix is reserved for the first-party catalog.

vendor.description: Vendor prefix all skill names in the pack must carry ({vendor}-{domain}[-{role}]). Exactly 'wicked' and 'wicked-*' are reserved (matching the runtime validator); other vendors that merely start with the letters 'wicked' are allowed.

skills_dir.description: Relative path to the skills tree (skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md). Must stay inside the pack.

domains.description: The domains this pack contributes. Each declared domain must have exactly one router skill named {vendor}-{domain}; its workers are {vendor}-{domain}-{role} fork skills. Required, except in a spec-2 pack that declares editors.

name.description: Bare domain name (e.g. seo). The crew-facing specialist domain becomes {vendor}-{name}.

specialist.description: Present iff this domain should be crew-routable (the pack equivalent of a specialist.json entry). Registered as {vendor}-{domain}; first-party names always win a collision.

enhances.description: Crew phases this specialist enhances: clarify | design | qe | build | review | operate | *

produces.description: Produces-contract declarations (extension-contract gap 5). Each names an archetype and the produces ids the domain's work yields; gates re-derive them via wicked-vault (`loom gate` consumes the produces id directly). Steering attach is documented in docs/extending.md — declared data today, auto-steering is the named seam.

archetype.description: One of garden's work-shape archetypes (.claude-plugin/archetypes.json): triage, explore, specify, decide, ship, review, incident, build, migrate, modernize.

produces.description: Kebab-case produces ids (the vault cross-check --phase values).

gate.description: Gate backend. Only the vault re-derivation gate exists; a pack never ships its own gate logic.

peers.description: Peer version floors (extension-contract gap 6), e.g. {"wicked-garden": ">=12.29.0", "wicked-vault": ">=0.5.0"}. Checked FAIL-OPEN: violations are surfaced at SessionStart and by `pack floors`, never blocked on.

provenance.description: Declared provenance (extension-contract gap 4 — minimal + honest). Registration additionally records a sha256 of this manifest and a content hash of the skills tree. There is NO signing: hashes detect post-registration drift, they do not prove authorship. Install packs only from sources you trust — skills carry shell.

source.description: Canonical origin URL (git repo or npm page).

editors.description: Spec 2. Artifact editors this pack ships (DES-artifact-editor-plugins §5.2). Each is ONE self-contained HTML entry inside the pack, pinned by sha256. `pack check` also verifies the file: inside the pack, the hash, the size, and no script/stylesheet/frame loaded from outside it.

id.description: Unique per install. 'wicked' and 'wicked-*' are refused in every pack: first-party editors ship inside studio.

title.description: Plain words, shown in Settings → Editors.

entry.description: Relative path of the single HTML file (scripts inline).

sha256.description: sha256 of the entry file; pinned at install.

sizes.description: 'inline' is required; a missing 'pane' morphs inline to full.

permissions.description: What it asks for (§6.1), each with its reason.

bundleBytes.description: May only be lower than the host's cap (5 MiB).

blocks.description: Spec 2. Blocks that PRODUCE this pack's kind (DES-artifact-editor-plugins §9.2): each names a crew preset file inside the pack and the pack skills it uses, approved together at install.

id.description: 'wicked' and 'wicked-*' are refused: first-party blocks are core presets.

label.description: Plain words the block is offered with.

preset.description: Relative path of the preset JSON inside the pack.

skills.description: Skills of this pack the block uses.
